items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: And almost overnight, Charlie Green stole the band from Oliver Todd. We stayed with the band maybe a couple of weeks.

ctx.x: Now in about late '33, Oliver Todd organized his little high school band. And at first, we had a male guy playing piano with us. I was much older than those guys, you know. But they'd come and get me out of the college, and I'd go down with my bass horn and we'd practice all those

things. And we had some gigs, you know And then the male singer left, and we got the girl singer, in Oliver Todd's group there. And somehow, he got an old alto player named Charlie Green, who had been in Clarence Love's band. And almost overnight, Charlie Green stole the band from Oliver Todd. We stayed with the band maybe a couple of weeks. So five of us just decided, since we're doing this-- by this time, it had become, like in '35, you know.
